retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic, low-angle cinematic composition featuring a central figure with large white wings holding a flag against a turbulent sky, anchored by heavy 3D textured typography.
triggerTerms: dramatic stormy sky with black flag

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, atmospheric scene depicting a central heroic figure standing on a rocky outcrop. The figure is flanked by expansive white feathered wings and holds a tall staff with a dark flag. The background is a swirling, desaturated blue and grey storm sky. The foreground is dominated by large, distressed 3D typography with a metallic red texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the vertical axis
Wings creating a wide 'V' shape to frame the subject
Flagpole providing a secondary vertical line
Heavy typography acting as a solid base/pedestal
Light source emanating from behind the figure to create a halo effect
coreInvariants: Distressed red metallic texture on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle third; wings span the horizontal width; typography dominates the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, 3D red logo at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright center of the wings, move down to the figure, then down to the heavy red text, and finally up the flagpole to the flag.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The stormy sky provides textured negative space that emphasizes the silhouette of the wings and flag.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated steel blue and charcoal grey (sky and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (wings and central light burst)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated crimson red with black shadows (typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright wings and dark sky; high saturation contrast between the red text and the muted background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with aggressive geometric modifications
letterConstructionRules: Deep 3D extrusion with a downward perspective
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integrated horizontal bars connecting multiple letters

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the mountain

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured 3D display type paired with a clean, widely-spaced secondary sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Iron Maiden style fonts
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and aggressive presence.
Good for the secondary widely-spaced subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic low-angle shot of a figure with large white angel wings standing on a dark rocky peak, holding a tall black flag against a swirling blue-grey stormy sky with a central light burst.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large 3D custom-lettered logo in the bottom third with a distressed red metallic texture and sharp geometric edges. Add a clean, white, widely-spaced sans-serif subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text 3D and textured?
Are the wings symmetrical and framing the subject?
Is the color palette dominated by blue-grey and red?
Is the perspective low-angle and heroic?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the red typography

avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the wings

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text feels integrated into the scene's lighting.
Check that the wings don't blend too much into the sky clouds.
Verify the red text is the most saturated element in the frame.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Heroic figure + expansive wings + stormy atmosphere + heavy 3D textured display type = Gothic Rock Aesthetic.
